subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】visit my grandparents 看望祖父母; see a film 看电影; take a trip 去旅行; go to the supermarket 去超市; this evening 今晚; this weekend 本周末; tomorrow 明天; next week 下周
【重点句型】What are you going to do? 你打算做什么？ I'm going to ... 我打算…… When are you going? 你什么时候去？ This evening/weekend. 今晚/本周末。 Sounds great! 听起来很棒！
【A Let's talk】Mike: What are you going to do tomorrow? Sarah: I'm going to have an art lesson. Mike: What are you going to do in your lesson? Sarah: We're going to draw pictures.
【Read and write】I have a busy weekend plan. On Saturday morning I'm going to do homework. In the afternoon I'm going to visit my grandparents. On Sunday I'm going to see a film and take a trip. Next week I'm going to the supermarket.
key_points: What are you going to do? 你打算做什么？
When are you going? 你什么时候去？
